courses.note: Required: C3 is CSCI 311 (algorithms), so the required systems course 306 fills C6. Fall 2026 has two sections (01, 02) on one shared course page. CSCI 315 Operating Systems Design and CSCI 307 Networks and Security are electives.

notes: Bucknell offers a BA, a BS and a BS in Computer Science & Engineering; the BS in Computer Science was chosen (it and the BA share C1-C4). The department also publishes common course policies with an AI section encouraging ethical use with attribution (https://csci.courses.bucknell.edu/shared/common-course-policies/, saved as .cache/text/v2c-bucknell-common.txt); that page is not a course syllabus.
